evidence.reason: At the supplied current code, line 449 flags a dependency name when either it is not in `expected` OR its source file is undeclared. That means an undeclared, unrelated unit file naming another CRQ unit (e.g. a sibling `crq-publisher.timer` naming `crq-publisher.service`) is appended to `foreign`, even though it cannot activate the switched unit. The intended distinction is the XOR of those conditions: flag an undeclared source only when it names an `expected` unit, and flag a declared source when it names a non-`expected` unit. Because a non-empty `foreign` list causes discovery to refuse, ordinary installed sibling CRQ units can make every switch refuse.
